substeps.caption: From the atomizer to the printer. The run's powder is in the rePowder's container, on the MiR250: four 5N Al cups with Si, Al-10Si, 157 g charged. Next, the sieving cell beside the rePowder, then the Aconity MIDI.

The sieving cell, in a downdraft enclosure, every metal part bonded to a ground bar. Left to right: a tipper over a funnel and five labelled jars, the Retsch AS 200, and the Al set's own stand: the lab's 8 in stack, No. 60, 100, 140, 230, 325 and the pan (DAL PR #175), nested in reverse, each sieve with a 12 mm handling tab at the front.
The arm builds the stack on the AS 200. It takes the top piece off the stand by its tab, lifts it clear of the one below, draws it out and sets it between the shaker's two rods: the pan first.

Coloured now only to tell them apart: the fractions, by the sieve that keeps each. The LPBF cut, 20-63 um, is the No. 325 and the pan: there is no 20 um sieve, and DAL found under 20 um is about 0.05 % by mass.
And back to grey: it is all the same powder, only sorted by size.
